messages.content: Here are the two options available: (A) calm and (B) rebuke. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: on cliff with moose
You should choose Calm because it keeps Emily calm and focused while the moose are near.
Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) comply. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: on the radio talking to the park ranger
You should choose Persist because it clearly communicates urgent danger and prompts a quicker rescue response.

Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) inform. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: still talking to the ranger after persisting the first time
You should choose Persist because it communicates urgent need and keeps the ranger focused on getting you help sooner.

Here are the two options available: (A) suspicious and (B) supportive. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily is panicking and matt has to help her cause she is barely holding on
You should choose Suspicious because it prompts a direct confrontation that clarifies Emily’s behavior and helps Matt address the immediate danger more effectively.
Here are the two options available: (A) sarcastic and (B) concerened. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: on the tower after being supportive
You should choose sarcastic because it quickly signals boundaries and prompts Emily to respond directly.
Here are the two options available: (A) insist and (B) concede. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: ashley saw a ghost and chris does not believe her
You should choose insist because it validates Ashley’s experience.

Here are the two options available: (A) dismissive and (B) sympathetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: talking about hannah and the situation they placed her in last year
You should choose A (dismissive) because it keeps the focus on the immediate danger.

Here are the two options available: (A) reluctant and (B) courageous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: chris is thinking about going further and ashley dont want to
You should choose Reluctant because it prioritizes safety and buys you time to plan.

Here are the two options available: (A) unrepentant and (B) apolegetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: they are watching the video on the projector of hannah
You should choose unrepentant because it preserves the prank’s playful tone and keeps the moment light.
